description: Routing fixture for type-design-review. Positive cases keep type/invariant/encapsulation design intents with this skill; negative controls keep general diff review with local-review, API-contract shape with api-design, and error handling with error-handling-review.

cases.prompt: Review the design of this new domain type — does it make illegal states unrepresentable and enforce its invariants at construction, or can a caller build an invalid instance?
This PR adds several new data model types — rate each one's encapsulation and invariant enforcement and flag any anemic models or exposed mutable internals.
Give this diff a general code review covering correctness, performance, and maintainability.
Design the HTTP API contract for this endpoint — the request and response schema, status codes, and pagination.
